about: Completeness questions grep answers badly: shared method names, overloads told apart by argument type, chained calls, and calls through test helpers. Answers verified by hand (2026-09-30; expand-tests corrected after the first run: SegmentBenchmark.time is a direct caller, and the disabled ignoreTestExpandDuringRefresh is optional); `forbid` lists the traps.

tasks.prompt: I want to change the contract of com.google.common.io.ByteSink.openStream(). Which methods in guava/src (main code, not android/, not tests) call openStream() on a ByteSink, i.e. on a ByteSink or subclass receiver, including implicit this? Don't include calls to openStream() on other types (ByteSource, CharSource, CharSink, URL). List every such method as Class.method, including nested classes (Outer.Inner.method).

ByteSource.copyTo has overloads for a ByteSink and for an OutputStream. Which methods in guava-tests/ (not android/) call ByteSource.copyTo with a ByteSink argument? Include test helper methods. Don't include calls with an OutputStream argument or calls to CharSource.copyTo. List every such method as Class.method.

Which methods in guava/src (main code, not android/) call com.google.common.cache.LocalCache.Segment.put(K key, int hash, V value, boolean onlyIfAbsent) directly? Only direct calls: not methods that reach it through another method. List every such method as Class.method.

Which methods in guava-tests/ (not android/) call com.google.common.cache.LocalCache.Segment.expand() directly, and which test methods call such a helper method? Don't include calls to expand() on other classes. List every such method as Class.method.
optional: ignoreTestExpandDuringRefresh (a disabled test: listing it or not are both fine)
